name: Profit Loss Calculator
summary: This EA is a profit/loss calculator utility that creates a graphical panel on the chart for computing potential profit and loss values. It does not open trades or implement any trading strategy, serving purely as a calculation and visualization aid for traders.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个盈亏计算器工具，在图表上创建一个图形面板用于计算潜在的盈利和亏损值。它不会开仓交易或实现任何交易策略，纯粹作为交易者的计算和可视化辅助工具。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略EA，而是一个实用工具类EA。它通过CProfitLossCalculator类创建一个图形界面面板，允许用户在图表上输入交易参数来计算潜在盈亏。入场条件和出场条件不适用于此EA，因为它不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理方面，该工具可能帮助用户计算不同手数下的盈亏情况，但本身不进行仓位管理。资金管理方面，它作为一个计算辅助工具，可能提供基于账户余额和风险的盈亏模拟功能。整体而言，这是一个纯计算展示工具，不涉及任何自动交易逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy EA but rather a utility tool. It creates a graphical interface panel through the CProfitLossCalculator class, allowing users to input trade parameters on the chart to calculate potential profit and loss. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since it does not execute any trading operations. Regarding position sizing, the tool may help users calculate profit and loss under different lot sizes, but it does not perform position management itself. For money management, it serves as a calculation aid that may provide profit and loss simulations based on account balance and risk parameters. Overall, this is a purely computational display tool with no automated trading logic involved.
pros: 提供直观的图形界面进行盈亏计算，便于交易者快速评估交易机会
作为独立工具EA运行，不干扰其他交易策略的执行
代码结构清晰，采用面向对象设计(CProfitLossCalculator类)，便于维护和扩展
pros_en: Provides an intuitive graphical interface for profit/loss calculation, enabling traders to quickly evaluate trading opportunities
Runs as a standalone utility EA without interfering with other trading strategies
Clean code structure using object-oriented design (CProfitLossCalculator class), making it maintainable and extensible
cons: 缺少输入参数的灵活性，面板尺寸和位置硬编码在OnInit中
错误处理较为简单，仅在创建失败时打印错误码，未提供用户友好的反馈
依赖外部头文件ProfitLossCalculator.mqh，无法从当前代码判断核心计算逻辑的可靠性
cons_en: Lacks flexibility in input parameters, with panel dimensions and positions hardcoded in OnInit
Error handling is simplistic, only printing error codes on creation failure without user-friendly feedback
Depends on external header file ProfitLossCalculator.mqh, making it impossible to assess core calculation logic reliability from the current code alone
improvements: 将面板的位置和尺寸参数化为可配置的输入变量，增强灵活性
添加更详细的错误处理和用户提示信息，例如在面板创建失败时显示消息框
improvements_en: Parameterize panel position and dimensions as configurable input variables for greater flexibility
Add more detailed error handling and user notification, such as displaying a message box when panel creation fails

risk_points: 该EA为纯工具类，不执行交易操作，无交易风险
图形面板创建失败时EA返回-1初始化失败，但未清理可能已分配的资源
risk_points_en: This EA is purely a utility tool with no trading operations, posing no trading risk
When graphical panel creation fails, the EA returns -1 for initialization failure but does not clean up potentially allocated resources

summary_en: This EA is a profit/loss calculator utility that creates a graphical panel on the chart for computing potential profit and loss values. It does not open trades or implement any trading strategy, serving purely as a calculation and visualization aid for traders.
